To audit the anatomical correctness of the human subject, specifically checking for subtle limb fusion or structural errors in the visible shoulder/neck area.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the boutonniere. AI often struggles with the thin stem connecting the flower to the lapel, often causing it to float or merge incorrectly. Also, verify the tie knot; it should have a distinct triangular geometry and not look like a melted blob of fabric. Check the hairline for any 'haloing' or unnatural blending into the background.
